title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Credit-Source Uplift on Refunds of Credit Balances
content:
These questions are answered from the credit-source rule for refunds of credit balances left on ended Bluegate Tenant Protection Plans.

**What is the credit-source uplift?**
A yearly rate that adds to the interest on a refund of a credit balance: the credit balance multiplied by the uplift and by the refund's late days, divided by 365. It depends on the kind of the latest fee credit on the plan's fee ledger.

**What are its values?**

| Latest fee credit on the plan | Credit-source uplift (a year) |
| --- | --- |
| a billing-error correction | 0.03 |
| a free-look refund credit | 0.01 |
| otherwise (no fee credit) | nothing |

**Which credit decides it when the plan carries several?**
Only the latest fee credit. A plan whose fee ledger shows a free-look refund credit followed by a later billing-error correction takes 0.03; the reverse order takes 0.01.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** A credit balance of 50.00 with 73 late days and a latest credit that is a billing-error correction: 50.00 multiplied by 0.03 and by 73, divided by 365, is 0.30.
